label: File to Text
description: Read a stored text file and emit its content as a String. For a file whose content a node needs as text (a document someone uploaded, a file TextToFile made). A file that is not text (an image, audio, video, or bytes that are not UTF-8) is refused, naming what it is. The text travels on a wire, so a file over 100 KB of text fails there: keep large text in the file and hand the file on instead.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: The stored text file to read.
